explication: TEN is a real-time multimodal conversational-AI framework, with agent examples and a runtime for composing extensions into graphs. The documented voice-assistant workflow accepts audio, transcribes it, generates a language-model response, and synthesizes speech; the wider examples also cover transcription, diarization, doodling, lip-sync avatars, SIP, and hardware. Internally, apps create and manage graph engines, while addon loading and message handling support runtime composition. Some domain branches are documented capabilities rather than inspected implementations; their links are cited to the README, not inferred from unsampled code.
